utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Gus, I’m still treating the repair drive details as tentative, but we’re gathering interest for Saturday morning in the community room—mostly bikes, small appliances, simple mending, and any tools or spare parts folks can bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Jules — I heard the latest is Sunday at the community center, so I’ll plan on setup and tool check-in, and I can bring spare tools, screws, cords, and gloves if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Gus—that would help a lot, but please hold the Sunday/community center plan lightly until Pia confirms, since I’d been working from tentative Saturday morning in the community room. I’ll flag you for setup and tool check-in once the date and spot are firm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Vik — latest I’ve heard is Sunday at the community center, and Rosa asked if I can greet folks and direct them to the right table. Can we confirm that’s the plan before I tell anyone else?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Morning, Eli — I’ve heard Saturday morning in the community room from Quinn, so I wouldn’t tell folks Sunday yet. Let’s check with Pia or Rosa first, and I’ll keep saying it’s unconfirmed until they lock it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s sensible, Vik — let’s hold off on spreading either version until Rosa or Pia confirms it. If you check with Pia, I’ll follow up with Rosa and we’ll compare notes before noon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll check in with Mara and Cleo now and get you whatever urgent repair list they have by tonight. So far I only know Tomas can help Saturday morning, Lila may have tools, and Ira offered a socket set, screwdrivers, and a Saturday morning table shift.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good — add Tomas to Saturday morning with Ira, and confirm Lila’s tools by tonight too. When you send the urgent list from Mara and Cleo, mark which fixes need parts versus tools only.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll confirm Lila’s tools, put Tomas and Ira on Saturday morning, and ask Mara and Cleo to flag each urgent fix as parts-needed or tools-only before I send it tonight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia, quick update—the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. Could you help spread the word and check whether anyone still needs transport for larger items?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll verify the Sunday community center change before I tell people, just to avoid confusion. I can also start quietly checking who might need transport for larger items.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Pia—yes, please verify it, and once you’re sure, let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center. A quiet transport check would be a big help, especially for anything bulky.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks again, Dane. With you on the sorting table at 10, I can keep the urgent fixes moving without getting pulled in every direction.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: You’ve got it, Uli—I’ll be there at 10 for the sorting table and I’ll check the tool, screw, and lamp spots before directing anyone.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Dane—that steadiness helps more than I can say. If Gus comes by with spare tools, could you have him set them near your table so we can keep track?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Faye — that sounds right from what I skimmed: porch table or community room for drop-offs, but let’s wait on Leo before treating Saturday late morning as firm.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Good catch on waiting, Bo — I actually just heard from Rosa that it’s shifted to Sunday at the community center, so I’m going to treat Saturday/porch details as outdated until Leo confirms.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh wow, thanks Faye — I’ll stop repeating the Saturday/porch version and wait for Leo to confirm Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Leo, perfect timing—can you help spread the word that the repair drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, for lamps, small appliances, bikes, and mending projects?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I’ll spread that exact list: Saturday 10–2 in the community room, for lamps, small appliances, bikes, and mending projects.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, thank you, Leo—and please mention we’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now if folks have any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Noah — I’m still getting it second-hand, but I’ve heard the repair drive is Saturday morning in the community room, with folks bringing small broken items, cords, gloves, spare screws, and any handy helpers they can find.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Nell — that matches what I’ve heard from Quinn, though I’m still waiting on Pia’s confirmed time and final repair list before I say it too firmly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wise, Noah — I’ll keep saying Saturday morning in the community room as tentative, and I’ll point folks to Pia or Quinn for the confirmed time and final list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mara, if I’m remembering Tess right, we’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now, and the repair drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That matches what I have too, Oren—Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room. If you hear of any urgent broken items, send me the item and owner so I can get Mina the list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara—I’ll pass along any urgent fixes with the item and owner for Mina tonight, assuming I don’t write it on the wrong scrap of paper.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, I just heard from Tess that they’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now, with repairs Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room—has Pia confirmed that matches what she has?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t had Pia confirm that yet, so I’d treat Tess’s list and the 10 to 2 timing as tentative until I check with Pia directly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, I’ll treat it as tentative and keep my socket set and screwdrivers ready until Pia confirms the final details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Opal, I don’t have anything confirmed yet—I’m still waiting on Pia before I tell people where to go. Can you confirm whether Bo has checked the porch table and community room yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t confirmed Bo’s check yet, so I’ll keep the porch table and community room marked pending until Bo—or Pia or Rosa—confirms them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Opal—please keep me posted when one of them confirms it. I won’t spread any locations until Pia or someone verified gives the go-ahead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I’m helping coordinate Saturday morning setup and tools for the repair drive—do you need me to plug you into check-in, sorting, or a repair table?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam—since the drive moved to Sunday at the community center, could you plug into check-in and sorting first? We’re still short on spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and bike or small-appliance helpers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll switch my notes to Sunday at the community center and start with check-in and sorting. I can bring spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves, and I’ll ask around for bike and small-appliance helpers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, I’m coordinating tools and Saturday morning setup for the repair drive—do you need help with check-in, tool sorting, or getting volunteers pointed to the right place?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam — tool sorting would help most, and if you can point early volunteers where to go Saturday morning, that’d save me a ton.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll take tool sorting and be there early Saturday to direct volunteers as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Uli. My latest word is that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’m planning to help greet folks unless Rosa tells me otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning, Eli — thank you, but I have it down for Saturday morning, with urgent home fixes first; greeting folks would still help a lot if you’re free then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Uli — I’ve got conflicting notes, so I won’t promise Saturday until Rosa confirms the change. If it is Saturday morning, I can greet folks and keep the sign-in sheet tidy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rosa! The repair drive is this Saturday morning in the community room, and we still need spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, plus anyone handy with bikes or small appliances—can you spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Quinn—I’ll spread the word, and quick update: it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll make sure folks bring screws, extension cords, gloves, and any bike or small-appliance skills there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks for catching that, Rosa—I’ll send the correction around now: Sunday at the community center, same needs for screws, extension cords, gloves, and bike or small-appliance helpers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — that matches what I’ve heard. I’ll also pass along that Ira may have a spare socket set and screwdrivers, plus a Saturday morning table shift if Mara or Cleo still need it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey—that’s a big help. I’ll note Ira for a possible socket set, screwdrivers, and a Saturday morning table shift, and I’ll check with Mara or Cleo so I don’t muddle the signup.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good, Oren. I’ll keep it as tentative on my end too until Mara or Cleo confirms where Ira fits.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Gus — I’m still confirming details before I share the repair drive notice; do you know for sure the date, repair categories, and whether we’re collecting tools only or small parts too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Hana — latest I have is it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and Rosa wants me on setup and tool check-in. I’d say hold the notice until we confirm the final time and whether small parts are okay, but tools are definitely being collected.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll hold the notice for now and only note that tools are confirmed, with Sunday/community center, final time, and small parts still needing confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, I’m catching up as usual—Pia hasn’t confirmed the time, place, or accepted items yet, so I’m holding off on sharing details, but I can note where you’d like to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Dane—Tess confirmed it’s Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and we’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now. Could you help note anyone with urgent broken items so I can add them to the list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Mara—I’ll start tracking urgent broken items and names, and I’ll send you the list as folks check in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Jules, have you heard about the repair drive? We’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now, and the fixing happens Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Tess—thanks for confirming the Saturday 10 to 2 slot. I’ll update Mina with those supply needs and nudge the garden crew, parents’ chat, and bike folks to bring what they can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s wonderful, Jules—thank you! If you tell them spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves are the big needs, that’ll keep everyone pointed the right way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, can you take a Saturday shift or bring any tools, and do you know of urgent fixes that Pia hasn’t listed yet?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can take a Saturday morning shift if Pia wants me there, but I won’t promise tools since Lila’s are still tentative; I’ll ask around for any urgent fixes that aren’t on Pia’s list yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, I’ll pencil you in for Saturday morning pending Pia’s say-so; please tell me by tonight if you hear of any urgent fixes so I can get them assigned.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Pia, quick update: I’m checking Rosa’s note that the repair drive may have shifted to Sunday at the community center, so hold off on sharing Saturday details until I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo—I'll keep everything on hold until you confirm, and I’ll also check with the office so we’re not juggling two different versions.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Pia. If the office confirms Sunday at the community center, text me and I’ll update everyone from my side.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Cleo — I’m still piecing it together second-hand, but I heard the repair drive is Saturday morning in the community room, with folks bringing small broken items, cords, gloves, spare screws, and handy helpers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Nell — I’ve got the same gaps noted: spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, plus bike and small-appliance helpers. Can you nudge anyone nearby who might bring those Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely, I can pass that along to a couple neighbors nearby and mention Saturday morning at the community room. I’ll stick to the list I’ve heard: screws, extension cords, work gloves, and handy folks for bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, I heard the repair drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and they’re collecting screws, extension cords, and work gloves—do you know if my socket set and screwdrivers would help too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Ira, I’d mark both socket set and screwdrivers as useful tools for Saturday in the community room. If you bring them, please label them so they’re easy to track and return.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll label the socket set and screwdrivers and bring them Saturday to the community room. Thanks for helping me pin that down, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Noah—yes, please check the signup sheet, but treat it as tentative until Pia confirms the time, location, and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Kira—I’ll peek at the signup sheet and keep it strictly tentative until Pia confirms the time, place, and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Noah—once you’ve checked it, just tell me what it says as tentative, and I’ll wait for Pia before passing anything along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sam, once you confirm the repair kits, tool area, and sign-up sheet spots, send them my way and I’ll update the location list before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do, Opal—I’m checking those spots today and I’ll send you the confirmed details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—I’ll hold the list as pending until your confirmation, then I’ll mark the locations clearly for Saturday’s 10–2 setup in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo—can you confirm the repair drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and that we’re collecting spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves now? I want to pass the right details to Opal and the school parents.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Almost—please tell Opal and the school parents it’s Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday in the community room. And yes, we’re still collecting spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, plus helpers for bikes or small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it—Sunday at the community center, with spare screws, extension cords, work gloves, and helpers for bikes or small appliances; I’ll update Opal and the school parents so no one uses the old Saturday details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Rosa—just checking I’ve got it right: the repair drive is Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and I’m bringing tape, spare batteries, plus any screws, cords, or gloves I can find.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren—quick correction: it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday; those supplies are perfect if you can still bring them then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, thank you, Rosa—I’d have shown up with batteries on the wrong day. I’ll change my note to Sunday at the community center and still bring the tape, spare batteries, screws, cords, and gloves if I can find them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Bo — before I pass anything along about the repair drive, can you confirm the date, the repair categories, and whether we’re collecting tools only or small parts too?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I only skimmed it, Hana, but I’ve got Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room, and we’re collecting small parts too—spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves. I don’t want to guess on the repair categories, so I’ll confirm that before you pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll hold off sharing until you confirm the repair categories, and I’ll note Saturday 10 to 2 in the community room plus small parts as tentative for now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, latest I’ve got is the repair drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m covering setup and tool check-in with my spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll update my list to Sunday at the community center and mark you down for setup and tool check-in with spare tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Mara — I’ll keep my tools labeled and bring a few extras in case folks show up short.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, Quinn—I’ll just mention Saturday morning in the community room and the supplies/help you listed, and I’ll hold off on Pia’s time or any final repair list until you confirm.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Noah—keep it to Saturday morning in the community room and the supplies/help for now. I’m checking Pia’s final time/list and I’ll ping you as soon as it’s solid.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll keep it to those basics and won’t add anything about Pia or the final list until you ping me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Kira, repair drive is Saturday 10–2 in the community room. Bring simple-fix items or help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Leo—but can you confirm Pia signed off on Saturday 10–2 in the community room before I pass that along?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good catch—I’ll confirm with Pia before you share it. Hold off for now, and I’ll get back to you shortly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rey, I’m passing along that Saturday morning is the repair drive, with urgent home fixes first, Tomas set, and Lila’s tools still tentative.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — that matches what I have. If Lila confirms tools or you hear of any urgent fixes before tonight, could you send that straight to me so I can keep Mara’s list clean?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Rey — if Lila confirms tools or I hear any urgent fixes before tonight, I’ll send them straight to you so Mara’s list stays clean.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mina, sorry I’m late jumping in—I'm pulling the repair drive pieces together now, but I’m still confirming the final time, place, and accepted items before we pass anything around.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Dane—when will you have the final time, place, repair categories, and whether we’re taking small parts as well as tools? I need that today so I can lock volunteers and urgent fixes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll chase Pia and cross-check with Jules and Leo now, then get you the confirmed time, place, categories, and small-parts/tools call by late afternoon today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Ira, I’m still piecing it together second-hand, but I heard Saturday morning in the community room is the main plan—sounds like your table shift and tools are a big part of making it work.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s what I’ve got too, Nell—Saturday morning in the community room. I’ll bring my socket set and screwdrivers and keep asking around for a couple more fixers today.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps, Ira—I'll keep telling folks Saturday morning in the community room, and I'll mention you're still looking for a couple more handy fixers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still confirming the community room with the office before we announce anything, Jules, but the plan we’re holding is Saturday 10 to 2 with spare screws, extension cords, and work gloves requested.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Pia — I’ll keep calling it tentative until the office confirms, but I’ll tell Noah and the others to hold Saturday 10 to 2 and start quietly checking for screws, extension cords, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s perfect, Jules—please keep it quiet and tentative for now, and I’ll let you know as soon as the office confirms the room.
